t: You're at the site of The Shed at Dulwich, which was never really a restaurant. It was a hoax by the journalist Oobah Butler, who pretended his garden shed was a fine dining restaurant. For Vice Magazine, he listed it online, and it rose to become the top-rated restaurant in London on TripAdvisor, before the listing was taken down. It opened for just one night in November 2017, and it served ten guests.
